material: Buddy Talks AUDIO FILE - The final -ed sounds
lesson.introText:
Hey guys! I’m BUDDY! Today, we’ll practice a very small ending that changes your past tense in English. It’s... …THE -ED ENDING! It has THREE sounds. Listen to this one: WALKED

When we say -ed correctly, people understand our past better. If we add one more syllable, like “walk-ED”, our English sounds strange.
